en.title: In-product GIF picker will be temporarily unavailable
en.description: Due to GFYCAT shutting down on September 1, 2023, the in-product picker will not work until a Mattermost fix is shipped in v9.0, [supported 8.x versions, and ESR versions](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/release-lifecycle.html). If GIFs are important to your instance, please consider upgrading your Mattermost instance to these versions as soon as it is available.

en.title: Mattermost 11.7.12 is now available
en.description: Mattermost v11.7.12 Extended Support Release contains Low to Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended.

en.title: Mattermost 12.0 is here!
en.description: Mattermost v12.0 contains multiple new quality of life improvements, including [Attribute Management](https://docs.mattermost.com/administration-guide/manage/admin/attribute-management), [Ranked and Hierarchical Attributes](https://docs.mattermost.com/administration-guide/manage/admin/attribute-management#create-an-attribute), [Channel Attributes and Labels](https://docs.mattermost.com/administration-guide/manage/admin/channel-attributes), [Session Attributes](https://docs.mattermost.com/administration-guide/manage/admin/session-attributes), and [Improved DM Calls Experience](https://docs.mattermost.com/end-user-guide/collaborate/make-calls). [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) only takes a few minutes.

en.title: Mattermost 10.11.23 is now available
en.description: Mattermost v10.11.23 Extended Support Release contains Low to High severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended.

en.title: Threaded Discussions are here, now in general availability!
en.description:
Experience a better way to communicate in threads that keeps your channels and conversations organized.

You can now enable Threaded Discussions by default for all users in **System Console** > **Posts** > **Threaded Discussions**.

en.title: Now enable Threaded Discussions by default for all users!
en.description: You can now enable Threaded Discussions by default for all users in **System Console** > **Posts** > **Threaded Discussions**.

en.title: Experience a better way to communicate in threads
en.description:
Welcome to Threaded Discussions! You can now find, follow, and resume conversations more easily, and keep discussion threads focused.

You can always disable it in **Settings** > **Display** > **Threaded Discussions**

en.title: Transitioning from Bleve Search in Mattermost v11
en.description: Experimental search functionality using [Bleve](https://docs.mattermost.com/administration-guide/configure/bleve-search.html) will be deprecated in Mattermost v11.0. We recommend configuring ``DisableDatabaseSearch`` to ``false`` before upgrading to avoid search issues. See more details in this [forum post](https://forum.mattermost.com/t/transitioning-from-bleve-search-in-mattermost-v11/22982).

en.title: Transitioning from certificate-based authentication in Mattermost v11
en.description: Experimental [certificate-based authentication](https://docs.mattermost.com/administration-guide/onboard/certificate-based-authentication.html) will be deprecated in Mattermost v11.0. We recommend configuring ``ExperimentalSettings.ClientSideCertEnable`` to ``false`` before upgrading to be able to start the server.

en.title: Your Mattermost server version is unsupported. Upgrading is required
en.description: You are on an unsupported Mattermost server version and it’s time to upgrade! [Read here](https://mattermost.com/blog/why-to-upgrade-mattermost-server/?utm_source=inapp-self-hosted&utm_medium=popup&utm_campaign=notification-why-upgrade-blog&utm_id=nov-notifications&utm_content=notification-why-upgrade-blog) on how we have improved server performance for Mattermost users, as well as why upgrading your Mattermost server ensures that you’re getting the latest new features, security fixes, and bug fixes.

en.title: atmos/camo image proxy support ending in v12.0
en.description:
Starting with **Mattermost v12.0 (October 2026)**, `atmos/camo` will no longer be supported as an image proxy. The `atmos/camo` project will be archived and will no longer be maintained.

If your `config.json` still has `ImageProxySettings.ImageProxyType` set to `atmos/camo`, your server will log a configuration error on startup and fail to start once you upgrade to v12.0. The `RemoteImageProxyURL` and `RemoteImageProxyOptions` settings will also be removed and ignored.

**Before upgrading**, update your configuration:
- Switch to the built-in **local** image proxy (set `ImageProxySettings.ImageProxyType` to `local`) — no external service required, and it includes SVG content blocking and security response headers.
- Or disable the image proxy entirely (set `ImageProxySettings.Enable` to `false`) if you don't need it.
